topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I always knew inventing was a gamble, a leap into the unknown. But to find out that the silent humming of my gears, the heart of my creation, has already been echoed elsewhere—well, it’s like walking through a familiar door only to find the room is not your own. The walls I thought were built with my dreams seem to have another architect. I must tread carefully now, recalibrate. The path forward is obscured, shrouded in the uncertainty of what’s mine to lay claim to and what belongs to the shadows of coincidence.
